notes.title: Patch Notes
notes.content:
Patch Notes:
- Gate to hold "E" now works as intended
- Players can no longer launch themselves off skulls
- Press E Prompt No longer pops up randomly
- Glitch where players skip the stockroom section via death is now fixed
- Witch Attack sounds replaced with more aggressive sound
